system.description:
Olganyar Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Common, Fire. 1 item slot (Small, Quickdraw). Uses: 8.

This long stick of bark can be chewed on, for a slightly animating effect. It’s probably not addictive.

Chew Caffeine (Reaction): As a reaction, you chew on a caffeine stick, consuming it. Gain 1AP before the end of your next turn. After that turn ends, you do not get a reaction until the start of the following turn. There are eight charges in this caffeine stick. When all are marked, the item is lost.

Rulebook p.57.
